status: Exploratory extension fixed before full CAD outcomes; no paper rewrite until results reviewed
network: Anonymized real-mine CAD-derived network; geometry not independently surveyed or hydraulically calibrated
primary_regions: Same four median-coordinate quadrants as prior screen; full enumeration of all non-exit, non-A source nodes in each
origins: All non-exit non-A nodes; report inside and outside source region separately
objective: Shortest single fixed route satisfying each target across every source in region, also report uncapped feasibility
secondary_source_set: Same-region nodes within 50 m of supplied CAD water-outline polygons; annotation-based sensitivity only, not ground-truth geological risk
algorithm: Constraint generation: solve exact shared-route subproblem, validate resulting path against all regional sources, add a violating source, repeat. Infeasibility of subset certifies full-set infeasibility; globally feasible shortest subset solution certifies full-set optimum. Time limits are unresolved, never failure.
validation: Cross-check vector deadline evaluation and constraint-generation search against existing full-scenario solver on prior 113-source network and selected CAD subsets before interpreting full results
limitations: Same volume-transfer proxy, mean depth and permanent closure; full node coverage does not imply continuous source coverage or actual mine safety
